digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent sync / outbound field diffing
propositions: DC 8.17.1 silently accepts and ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task rather than rejecting or updating it (req-0056/0058 reproduced live in run 30951453979)

rebar's _resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) for a non-epic parent identically to its 'unbound, retry next pass' return, so a divergent non-epic parent never enters fields and the entire record_parent_divergence / bridge_alerts apparatus is structurally unreachable
the three failing cells (inbound_set, outbound_set, outbound_clear) were wrong oracles asserting unsupported sub-task operations rather than symptoms of the emit-time silence defect

the supported mechanism for parent reparenting on DC is the Epic Link field on non-sub-task children, already green in the same run (test_outbound_epic_parent_reaches_dc_THROUGH_A_RECONCILE_PASS PASSED)

re-homed cells must assert the user-visible outcome end-to-end: a set parent reaches local parent_id inbound, a divergent non-epic parent surfaces an operator-visible bridge alert with reason and alternative, and a clear parent clears through a pass
the suppressed non-epic parent that diverges from the remote must produce a durable record (bridge alert) before the pass exits 0 with convergence reported
